justification: Assessment returned INVALID and explicitly refutes Theorem \ref{second} -- the claim that a binary self-dual Gray image forces the Z_4 code to be self-dual -- which is exactly the ground-truth flaw. It uses the identical witness C = <(1,1)> in Z_4^2, computes the same Gray image (both the permuted {0000,0011,1111,1100} and the interleaved {0000,0101,1111,1010} of the ground truth), verifies its binary self-duality, and shows [(1,1),(1,1)]_4 = 2 != 0 so C is not Z_4-self-dual. Independently checked: C = {00,11,22,33} is closed under addition; Gray images 1->01, 1->01 give 0101, 2->11 gives 1111, 3->10 gives 1010; 0101.0101 = 0, 1010.1010 = 0, 0101.1010 = 0, dimension 2 length 4 => binary self-dual; C^perp = {(a,b): a+b = 0 mod 4} != C. Correct. The assessment additionally flags the upstream torsion theorem with the same mod-2 vs mod-4 gap, but that is the same defect propagated, not a substitution.
